big_case.notes: Overton sought to halt his imminent execution. A ruling on an alleged categorical exclusion from clemency or on access to clemency records could affect other Florida prisoners under death warrants. The Court disposed of the application and petition without announcing a rule.

leakage.notes: All ten calls in the November 17 forward log have captured results. The linked-petition query carries a November 14 document date, and the candidate reports that the petition was pending. The November 16 case summary and other recent denials preceded the November 19 order. Neither the log nor the analysis shows advance access to it.
